project.title: HeyPCB Power Kit
project.summary: Six open power and charging boards from HeyPCB: buck module, USB-C PD trigger, 1S boost, USB/battery power mux, USB eFuse and a USB-C power meter. KiCad 10, JLCPCB-ready, CERN-OHL-S-2.0.

boards.title: HeyPCB Dual Rail
boards.summary: A dual-rail buck module: 6-15 V in, 5 V / 3 A and 3.3 V / 2 A out, reverse-polarity protected. 50 x 36 mm, 4 layers, KiCad 10. Not yet fabricated.

boards.title: HeyPCB PD Trigger
boards.summary: A USB-C Power Delivery trigger: any PD charger in, a fixed 5, 9, 12, 15 or 20 V at 3 A out on a screw terminal, picked with a DIP switch. 28 x 40 mm, 2 layers, KiCad 10. Not yet fabricated.

boards.title: HeyPCB 1S Boost
boards.summary: One lithium cell in, 5.1 V out: an MT3608 boost with a JST PH input and a 2.54 mm header. 28 x 30 mm, 2 layers, KiCad 10. Not yet fabricated.

boards.title: HeyPCB Power Mux
boards.summary: USB-C first, a lithium cell as backup: a TPS2116 ideal-diode power mux with no diode drop and a pin that says which source is live. 28 x 32 mm, 2 layers, KiCad 10. Not yet fabricated.

boards.title: HeyPCB USB eFuse
boards.summary: A 5 V eFuse between a USB-C supply and your project: about 2 A current limit, output clamped at 6.1 V, rides out a 20 V input, soft start and auto-retry. 26 x 30 mm, 2 layers, KiCad 10. Not yet fabricated.

boards.title: HeyPCB USB-C Power Meter
boards.summary: Put it in a USB-C cable run and read volts, amps and watts over Qwiic: an INA226 on a 10 mOhm shunt in VBUS, with CC and USB 2.0 passed straight through. 32 x 24 mm, 2 layers, KiCad 10. Not yet fabricated.
